semantic.justification: Original complete CSS1 token/state/selector values, linked selector/expression fields, reset/operator/length contracts and native URL/Color operations. CSS1Expression out parameters use ordinary JS reference cells or actual mutable Color values; UTF16 views adapt immutable strings to existing SAL/o3tl. Source color and lexer quirks are preserved as WRITER160..165. Native allocator/ABI, out-of-domain floating casts and compiled full Writer parity are not claimed.
